Row.Text: World Bank loan approved
You got {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] Gold from the World Bank (loan {1_LoanID}). Payments show in the Bank panel.
Loan payment missed
You couldn't cover {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] Gold on loan {1_LoanID}. It's now in arrears and picks up a fee each turn.
Default warning
You've been in arrears for {1_Turns : number #} turns. Pay it down soon or you'll go into default.
You're in default
The World Bank put you in default. It takes part of your income each turn and your cities take penalties until the arrears are paid.
Default got worse
You're still in default, so the penalties are heavier now and the bank takes more of your income.
Out of default
Your arrears are paid and the default penalties are gone. Your credit stays scarred for a while.
Loan restructured
Loan {2_OldLoanID} is now loan {1_LoanID} with a longer schedule. It cost {3_Favor : number #} [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor.
Debt relief granted
You hit your relief milestone, so the World Bank forgave {1_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] Gold of your debt.
Loan milestone reached
You reached the milestone on loan {1_LoanID}. {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] Gold of principal was forgiven.
Deposit matured
Deposit {1_DepositID} paid out {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] Gold. {3_Arrears : number #} of it went to your arrears first.
Deposit withdrawn
You pulled deposit {1_DepositID} early and got {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] Gold. {3_Arrears : number #} of it went to your arrears first.
You're World Bank President
You're the bank's biggest investor, so you get the President perks and can see everyone's debts.
No longer President
You're not the World Bank President anymore. The President perks and any President freeze have ended.
Lending freeze placed
Freeze {1_FreezeID} is on (involves player {2_PlayerID}). The frozen civ can't take new World Bank loans while it lasts.
Lending freeze lifted
Freeze {1_FreezeID} has ended, so new World Bank loans are possible again.
Disaster recovery loan offered
The World Bank offers you a recovery loan after a disaster. Claim it in the Bank panel before turn {3_Turn : number #}.
Recovery loan claimed
Your disaster recovery loan is paid out as loan {2_LoanID}.
Recovery offer expired
You didn't claim the disaster recovery loan in time, so the offer is gone.
Development grant paid
The World Bank paid you a {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] Gold development grant. You don't pay it back.
Development tier changed
The World Bank now rates you {1_Tier} (was {2_OldTier}). That changes which loans you can get and on what terms.
The bank couldn't apply that, so nothing changed. Lua.log has the details.
